$comment: The golden seed (#11125): one world the authoring tools export and the CMS atlas shows, so the generator's output can be watched change from run to run and its parts referred to by a stable current reference. export.py reads this; nothing in the game does. Pixels is the continent raster's side. Windows are squares at walking detail (half-side and step in metres): one about each town the game places, plus any named here as {name, x, z}.
